draft_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline significantly outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: On the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set, Tessaline significantly outperformed Varrow-NMT in BLEU (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
